serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Shanice: No, why would I?
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceSerious
You: I met him on the streets after leaving you last time. We had a talk.
Shanice: Oh.
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceNormal
Shanice: I guess it can’t be helped, haha! 
Shanice: He seemed kinda down, now when I think about it.
Shanice: What exactly did you tell him?
You: Nothing! I was trying to bullshit him, but he noticed. That’s all.
Shanice: It should be fine, if my concerns are unfounded. Hopefully he will sulk a little and forget about it. Still, we need to keep an eye on him, just in case.
Shanice: Oh, by the way. He knows about the stuff you do on the internet.
You: W-what?!
Shanice: Well, I had to tell him something! It was you who acted suspicious in the first place. Just take this one for the team and stop complaining! It’s not a big deal anyway!
You: If you say so…
Shanice: He’s at the back, let me go for him so he doesn’t feel alienated.
